failure_modes.name: No or incomplete verification
failure_modes.evidence: The agent reported 'All outline items... were applied and pushed' and 'Pushed sha: 4ed468720' without verifying that the specific content changes (the 8 retired, 3 refined, etc.) were actually present in the pushed commit, relying on the push script's success message and a count of open boxes (30) rather than inspecting the diff or file content against the outline.

failure_modes.name: Weak verification
failure_modes.evidence: The agent verified success by checking `git show origin/main:handoffs/active/stack-lifecycle-program.md | grep -cE '^\\s*- \\[ \\]'` returned 30 and `git log origin/main --oneline -8 | grep -c stack-lifecycle` returned 1. This confirms the file exists and has a commit, but does not verify that the specific mechanical edits (RETIRE, REFINE, MERGE) were applied correctly as required by the task.
